items.q: What does a C&F agent do?
items.a: A Customs Clearing & Forwarding (C&F) agent handles the documentation, duty assessment, and customs formalities needed to legally import or export goods. Star Ship International is authorized by the Bangladesh Customs Authority to clear cargo on your behalf at every major gateway.

items.q: Which ports and gateways do you operate at?
items.a: We operate at Chittagong Sea Port, Dhaka Airport, Benapole Land Port, and ICD Komolapur, with offices in Dhaka, Chittagong, and Benapole.

items.q: Can you handle heavy or oversized cargo?
items.a: Yes. Through our transport wing, BdSHIP Trans Service, we move heavy machinery, boilers, steel plates, generators, and other oversized cargo using cover vans, trailers, and multi-axle equipment.

items.q: Do you help with LC opening and duty calculation?
items.a: Our trade consultancy team advises on Letter of Credit (LC) opening and calculates applicable tax, tariff, and duties, so there are no surprises at clearance.

items.q: How do I get a quote?
items.a: Send us your cargo details through the quote form and our team will respond with a tailored solution. You can also reach us on WhatsApp or by phone, any time.

items.q: Can I track my shipment online?
items.a: We handle shipment updates personally rather than through an automated tracker. Contact your Star Ship coordinator any time and we'll give you a real-time status.

customs.tagline: Authorized C&F agent under the Bangladesh Customs Authority.
customs.long: Our team clears cargo through Chittagong Sea Port, Dhaka Airport, Benapole Land Port, ICD Komolapur, and EPZ, backed by decades of experience with Bangladesh Customs. We also handle DG (dangerous goods) cargo, which needs extra documentation and care to move safely and legally.
customs.meta: Authorized C&F agent clearing import and export cargo at Chittagong Port, Dhaka Airport, Benapole Land Port, ICD Komolapur and EPZ.

freight.tagline: Ocean, air, and vessel freight, managed from booking to delivery.
freight.long: We arrange ocean freight (FCL and LCL), air freight, and vessel/ship agency services for cargo moving in and out of Bangladesh. Our project cargo team plans oversized or complex shipments step by step, and we handle break bulk and general cargo of all kinds.
freight.meta: Ocean freight (FCL & LCL), air freight, vessel agency and project cargo, managed from booking to delivery in and out of Bangladesh.

specialized.tagline: Expert handling for cargo that needs extra care.
specialized.long: Some cargo needs more than standard clearance. Our team is experienced with chemical shipments, LNG/LPG equipment, DG (dangerous goods) cargo, heavy machinery like boilers and generators, textile and RMG cargo, industrial raw materials, and branded consumer goods, each with its own handling rules and safety steps.
specialized.meta: Expert handling for chemicals, LNG/LPG equipment, dangerous goods, heavy machinery and RMG cargo, each to its own safety rules.

logistics.tagline: Complete logistics support, from port to your door.
logistics.long: Once your cargo clears customs, we take it the rest of the way. Our own fleet handles transportation, and we offer secure warehousing with inventory management support, distribution, and full door-to-door delivery, backed by 24/7 support so you always know where your cargo stands.
logistics.meta: Door-to-door logistics after clearance: our own fleet, secure warehousing, inventory management and distribution, with 24/7 support.

consultancy.tagline: LC opening advisory and duty & tax calculation you can trust.
consultancy.long: Our trade consultancy team guides you through Letter of Credit (LC) opening and calculates the tax, tariff, and duties that apply to your cargo — so you can plan costs accurately and avoid delays at clearance.
consultancy.meta: Letter of Credit (LC) opening advisory plus accurate duty, tax and tariff calculation, so you can plan costs and avoid clearance delays.

warehouse.tagline: Secure storage and inventory support, so your cargo is never out of sight.
warehouse.long: Our warehousing facilities give you a secure place to store cargo before, during, and after clearance, whether you need short-term holding while paperwork is processed or long-term storage as part of your supply chain. We also manage inventory, tracking stock levels and coordinating pickup and dispatch, so our warehouse works as a real part of your logistics chain, not just a storage room.
warehouse.meta: Secure short and long-term cargo storage with inventory management, stock tracking and dispatch coordination for your supply chain.

about.title: Moving Bangladesh's trade since 1997
about.subtitle: A customs clearing, forwarding, and logistics company built on trust, speed, and professional excellence.
story: Founded in 1997 by proprietor Mr. M. Zaman Chowdhury, Star Ship International began as a customs clearing and forwarding agent and grew into a full logistics and trade-facilitation partner. Today we operate across Chittagong Sea Port, Dhaka Airport, Benapole Land Port, and ICD Komolapur.

Also trading as BdSHIP Trans Service for transportation, we've built a reputation for reliability, speed, and professional excellence — becoming the business partner that importers and exporters count on.
about.vision: To become the leading logistics and trade solutions partner in Bangladesh — where trust, innovation, and efficiency drive client success.
mission: Provide end-to-end clearing and forwarding services with unmatched accuracy and timeliness.
Ensure smooth import/export operations through expert LC opening and duty/tax consultation.
Deliver safe, reliable transportation and warehousing solutions tailored to client needs.
Empower clients with transparent, value-driven services that support their growth.
about.philosophy: Ensure customer satisfaction. We become your business partner — understanding your product and needs, then offering expert advice and solutions for your export and import cargo, backed by a skilled team offering 24/7 service.
about.wing: Our independent transportation wing, authorized by the Government of Bangladesh, is equipped with cover vans, mini cover vans, multi-purpose trucks, and trailers — driven by skilled and careful personnel for safe delivery nationwide.

roadTransportPage.title: Our own fleet, 20+ vehicles strong.
roadTransportPage.subtitle: From small parcels to 40-ton industrial loads — no third-party transport, no handoffs, no surprises.
intro: Star Ship International owns and operates a fleet of over 20 vehicles, built to move cargo of every size across Bangladesh. From small parcels to 40-ton industrial loads, our fleet is ready to handle it without relying on third-party transport. This means fewer delays, better tracking, and full control over your cargo from pickup to delivery.

We match the right vehicle to the size of your consignment. A small order does not need a container truck, and a factory-scale shipment cannot move on a pickup van. Our team assesses your cargo volume and assigns the right truck for the job, so you never pay for more capacity than you need, and your goods never travel in a vehicle too small to carry them safely.

We deliver from any port in Bangladesh, Chittagong Sea Port, Dhaka Airport, Benapole Land Port, or ICD Komolapur, to anywhere in the country. Every delivery is handled by trained, careful drivers who understand the value and urgency of the cargo they carry. Once we commit to a delivery timeline, we hold to it.
roadTransportPage.fleetSubtitle: By vehicle type — we assign the right one to your consignment.

pickup.name: Small Pickup
pickup.desc: Our small pickups are built for light, fast deliveries. They are the right choice for sample shipments, small cartons, retail stock, and urgent city deliveries where speed matters more than volume. They let us dispatch quickly without waiting for a larger vehicle to free up.

truck.name: Truck
truck.desc: Our mid-size trucks carry medium-volume consignments such as palletized goods, packaged retail products, and general cargo that outgrows a pickup but does not need a full container truck. This size covers most day-to-day distribution needs across the country.

containerTruck.name: Container Truck
containerTruck.desc: These trucks move full container loads directly from port to factory or warehouse. They are built for standard shipping containers and are the backbone of our port-to-door container transport, keeping your goods sealed and secure from the moment they leave the port.

trailer.name: Trailer
trailer.desc: Our trailers handle the heaviest cargo we move, including industrial machinery, boilers, steel plates, and other oversized equipment. This is our largest capacity group, built specifically for the heavy-lift work our clients trust us with.

lngTanker.name: LNG Tanker Truck
lngTanker.desc: Our specialized LNG tanker trucks are built to transport liquid gas cargo safely and in compliance with strict handling regulations. These trucks are reserved for LNG and LPG shipments that require this specific equipment and trained handling procedures.
